itens.t: North Korea fires salvo of around 10 ballistic missiles toward sea, Seoul says
itens.r: North Korea has launched a salvo of approximately ten short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea off its east coast, according to South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff. The provocative missile launch comes amid heightened cross-border tensions and ongoing military developments in the region. Seoul's military is closely monitoring the situation in coordination with international allies. Observers note this marks a significant new escalation in Pyongyang's recent missile testing activities.

itens.t: Russian drone strike kills at least 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
itens.r: A deadly Russian drone strike struck a crowded Ukrainian rail platform, killing at least 14 people and injuring many others. The attack highlights the ongoing vulnerability of civilian infrastructure as the conflict persists.

itens.t: Netanyahu falls short of majority as Israel faces three possible paths to a new government
itens.r: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's governing coalition remained well short of a parliamentary majority as newly counted ballots showed a surge in support for Arab parties. The political deadlock leaves the nation weighing multiple potential paths to form a stable government.

itens.t: US economic growth accelerates in third quarter
itens.r: United States economic growth accelerated in the third quarter, surpassing expectations and demonstrating continued resilience despite broader global economic pressures. Consumer spending and robust market activity heavily drove the positive quarterly figures.

itens.t: DoorDash strikes $17 billion deal for US rival Instacart in mega grocery delivery bet
itens.r: DoorDash has agreed to acquire its US rival Instacart for $17 billion in a massive consolidation of the grocery delivery market. The mega-deal significantly expands DoorDash's footprint in retail delivery logistics.

itens.t: SpaceX's Starfall capsule delivers cargo for US Air Force in landmark mission
itens.r: The U.S. Air Force has revealed details about the SpaceX Starfall cargo capsule used in a recent point-to-point orbital mission. The landmark flight successfully demonstrated rapid global cargo delivery capabilities.

itens.t: N. Korea builds military leader narrative around Kim Ju-ae, says Seoul spy agency
itens.r: South Korea's National Intelligence Service reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's daughter, Ju-ae, is solidifying her status as his designated successor. Pyongyang is actively shaping a military-focused leadership narrative around her.

itens.t: South Korea and Germany forge enhanced strategic partnership
itens.r: South Korea and Germany have agreed to elevate their bilateral ties to an enhanced strategic partnership during high-level talks. Both nations pledged to expand collaboration into advanced technologies, future industries, and defense security.

itens.t: AI breakthrough from Anthropic and OpenAI challenges computer science tenet
itens.r: Leading artificial intelligence labs Anthropic and OpenAI have published findings that appear to challenge a fundamental tenet of computer science. Researchers are grappling with the implications while exploring exciting new theoretical avenues.

itens.t: Mistral AI releases open-weight model 'Le Chonk' targeting developers
itens.r: French artificial intelligence lab Mistral has unveiled its new open-weight model, 'Le Chonk,' claiming it matches or beats top competitors in coding and cybersecurity performance. The release marks another milestone in Europe's independent AI race.

itens.t: Astronomers discover possible new dwarf planet beyond Neptune
itens.r: The Vera Rubin Observatory has identified a distant icy object dubbed 2026 ED138 orbiting beyond Neptune. Measuring up to 1,500 kilometers wide, it is a prime candidate to be classified as a new dwarf planet.

itens.t: Hugo Calderano dominates Shinozuka to advance at WTT Montpellier
itens.r: Brazilian table tennis star Hugo Calderano delivered a commanding performance to defeat Japan's Hiroto Shinozuka in straight sets at the WTT Champions event in Montpellier. The victory comfortably propels Calderano into the next round.

itens.t: Ex-Palmeiras youngster Riquelme Filipi rescues Inter Miami with late goal
itens.r: Former Palmeiras winger Riquelme Filipi scored his debut goal for Inter Miami in dramatic fashion to secure a draw against Cincinnati. The late equalizer salvaged a vital point for the team featuring Lionel Messi.

itens.t: Samsung Lions edge out Tigers, stand on verge of KBO postseason series victory
itens.r: The Samsung Lions hit two home runs to edge out the Kia Tigers in a tense postseason matchup. The victory places the Lions on the absolute verge of claiming the KBO playoff series.

itens.t: Video: How many refueling flights does NASA actually need for Starship?
itens.r: This video breaks down recent statements by NASA's Artemis program manager regarding the stark contrast between safety estimates and Elon Musk's projections for Starship refueling missions.

itens.t: Video: SpaceX prepares Booster 22 for Flight 15 and ambitious double-catch maneuver
itens.r: This video covers the static fire test of Booster 22 on Pad 2 and SpaceX's bold plans to catch both halves of Starship during the upcoming landmark Flight 15 test.

itens.t: US inflation heats up in September as consumer spending rises
itens.r: US consumer prices picked up pace in September while consumer spending registered steady increases. The data complicates the macroeconomic outlook as central banks monitor inflationary pressures.

itens.t: ECB keeps rates unchanged but warns of mounting inflation risks
itens.r: The European Central Bank left its key interest rates steady while signaling heightened vigilance toward growing inflation risks. Policymakers stressed that economic conditions remain unpredictable.

itens.t: Hegseth fires top Pentagon strategist amid classified leak investigation
itens.r: War Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a senior Pentagon strategic planner over an active probe into alleged leaks of classified military information. The documents reportedly touched on sensitive operations regarding Iran and Ukraine.

itens.t: Iran's hidden web of military agencies slips hardware past US blockade
itens.r: Investigations reveal that a clandestine network of Iranian military agencies continues to bypass US blockades to smuggle hardware. The sophisticated channels highlight ongoing enforcement gaps in international sanctions.

itens.t: Taliban's poppy ban falters as Afghan farmers struggle to feed families
itens.r: Efforts by the Taliban to enforce a nationwide poppy cultivation ban are faltering as impoverished Afghan farmers state they cannot otherwise feed their children. Economic desperation continues to drive illegal crop production.

itens.t: Fighting rages near Yemen's Taiz as UN urges immediate humanitarian access
itens.r: Renewed fighting near Yemen's Taiz has displaced over 281,000 people since August, prompting urgent pleas from the United Nations for safe humanitarian access. Local populations face severe shortages of aid and basic necessities.

itens.t: South Korean prosecutors press for death sentence in Yoon martial law case
itens.r: South Korean prosecutors have demanded the death penalty for former president Yoon Suk Yeol as he appeals his life sentence for insurrection. The high-profile case stems from the political fallout of his short-lived martial law declaration.

itens.t: SpaceX fires up Starship upper stage ahead of landmark Flight 15 test
itens.r: SpaceX successfully completed static-fire tests with Starship's upper stage ahead of its 15th integrated test flight. The milestone brings the aerospace company closer to executing its next ambitious launch campaign.

itens.t: Stunning solar eclipse photos reveal giant hole and smoke rings in sun's atmosphere
itens.r: Researchers released detailed photographs of the sun captured during the August 12 total solar eclipse. The high-resolution images expose coronal holes and unusual structures in the solar atmosphere with unprecedented clarity.

itens.t: Startup &Truth tackles mathematical formal verification to secure AI code
itens.r: A new startup named &Truth is entering the software automation sector to prove code correctness through rigorous mathematical verification. The tool aims to bring reliability and safety to modern automated programming.

itens.t: South Africa names Durban in bid to host 2036 or 2040 Olympic Games
itens.r: South Africa has officially designated Durban as its candidate host city for the 2036 or 2040 Olympic Games. The bid marks a concerted effort to bring the prestigious global sporting event to the African continent for the first time.

itens.t: IFI urges quick announcement of new fiscal plan to anchor Brazilian expectations
itens.r: Following the electoral cycle, the Senate's Independent Fiscal Institution (IFI) has urged President Lula's economic team to unveil a robust fiscal adjustment plan as soon as possible. Experts argue clear fiscal anchors are vital to stabilize market confidence.

itens.t: Gaeco targets top echelons of PCC criminal faction in Santa Catarina and Paraná
itens.r: State prosecutors and police launched a coordinated morning operation to dismantle the leadership structure of the Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) crime syndicate. Raids focused heavily on western Santa Catarina and neighboring regions.

itens.t: Designer Sasha Meneghel announces first pregnancy with singer João Lucas
itens.r: Fashion designer Sasha Meneghel and her husband, singer João Lucas, publicly shared that they are expecting their first child. The couple announced the joyous news across their social media platforms to widespread well-wishes.

itens.t: Volkswagen's third-quarter loss swells past $6.5 billion amid market headwinds
itens.r: Volkswagen posted its worst quarterly result in over a decade as the global automotive giant battles severe headwinds in key international markets.

itens.t: Shell reports highest quarterly profit since 2022 and expands share buybacks
itens.r: Energy major Shell posted its strongest quarterly earnings in two years, fueled by elevated wartime energy prices and exceptionally strong refining margins.

itens.t: Italian lawmaker requests official probe into citizenship process of Bolsonaro brothers
itens.r: An Italian green party parliamentarian formally requested that government ministries investigate the citizenship application processes for Carlos, Eduardo, and Flávio Bolsonaro.

itens.t: STF President Fachin dismisses five investigations tied to fake news inquiry
itens.r: Supreme Court President Luís Edson Fachin ordered the formal closure of five separate investigative threads linked to the broader fake news inquiry.

itens.t: Simpsons character Apu speaks again after nine-year dialogue hiatus
itens.r: Convenience store owner Apu Nahasapeemapetilon finally delivered spoken lines in a recent episode, ending a nearly decade-long absence of voice dialogue.

itens.t: Tevez reveals unfulfilled Ferguson promise and admits Manchester City move was revenge
itens.r: Former Argentine striker Carlos Tevez opened up about his acrimonious exit from Manchester United and why joining cross-town rivals City felt like vindication.

itens.t: Roger Federer to visit São Paulo in December for exhibition match with João Fonseca
itens.r: Tennis legend Roger Federer confirmed he will return to Brazil in December to share the court with young Brazilian rising star João Fonseca in a special exhibition event.

itens.t: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates fan vote naming him greatest Ballon d'Or winner ever
itens.r: Portuguese football icon Cristiano Ronaldo expressed gratitude after winning a public global poll celebrating the ultimate Ballon d'Or recipient of all time.

itens.t: Ex-police chief recalls killer Christa Pike being 'almost giddy' during confession
itens.r: A retired investigator remembered convicted murderer Christa Pike showing unsettling enthusiasm while detailing her brutal crime as state execution decisions loom.

itens.t: DHS informed 60 Minutes that deported Malian man previously claimed asylum as gay
itens.r: Federal officials stated they warned journalists weeks prior to a sympathetic broadcast that a deported asylum seeker had previously altered aspects of his personal narrative.

itens.t: Three bodies recovered in Gabon following sinking of Borr Drilling rig
itens.r: Search teams off the coast of Gabon have recovered three bodies following the tragic sinking of a commercial drilling rig operated by Borr Drilling.

itens.t: Rockfall at Turkey's Cappadocia tourist attraction kills two after heavy rains
itens.r: A sudden geological collapse of famed fairy chimney rock formations in Cappadocia killed two individuals following heavy regional precipitation.

itens.t: Eli Lilly lifts revenue forecast as weight-loss drug demand offsets other misses
itens.r: Pharmaceutical giant Eli Lilly raised its full-year revenue outlook, driven by surging international demand for its advanced weight-loss treatments.

itens.t: Pentagon treats military base freezer malfunctions as potential cyberattack
itens.r: Defense authorities are investigating mysterious equipment failures involving refrigeration units at multiple military installations as a suspected targeted cyber intrusion.

itens.t: Mistral AI publicly rolls out Large 4 model tailored for cybersecurity professionals
itens.r: European artificial intelligence developer Mistral released its advanced Large 4 system with a specific focus on bolstering digital defense and cybersecurity operations.

itens.t: YouTube star Jake Paul schedules Dubai boxing comeback for Christmas Eve
itens.r: American internet personality and boxer Jake Paul announced plans to headline a high-profile professional boxing event in Dubai this coming Christmas Eve.

itens.t: Striker Ivan Toney pleads not guilty to assault charges at London nightclub
itens.r: Footballer Ivan Toney formally entered a not-guilty plea in response to allegations that he physically assaulted a patron outside a venue in London.

itens.t: South Korea coach backs captain Son Heung-min despite reported squad rift
itens.r: National team manager Robert Moreno firmly included star forward Son Heung-min in South Korea's upcoming roster, dismissing rumors of internal locker room discord.

itens.t: Officials blame control center error for second Spanish high-speed train crash
itens.r: Investigators pointed to signaling system failures and erroneous control center directives as the root cause of Spain's latest catastrophic railway accident.

itens.t: Virgin Galactic unveils first Delta-class space plane named Apeiron
itens.r: Virgin Galactic publicly showcased its next-generation commercial space plane, christened 'Apeiron,' marking a major milestone for its Delta-class fleet.

itens.t: Vietnam signs Artemis Accords to join international space exploration pact
itens.r: Vietnam officially became the 78th nation to sign the Artemis Accords, committing to transparent and peaceful cooperation in space exploration.

itens.t: Hisense UR8 RGB MiniLED TV offers exceptional color accuracy on a budget
itens.r: Reviewers highlighted the Hisense UR8 RGB MiniLED television as a competitively priced display delivering impressive color precision compared to pricier rivals.

itens.t: US sanctions 10 North and Russian nationals over fraudulent IT worker schemes
itens.r: Washington imposed fresh sanctions targeting individuals involved in illicit technology labor networks that allegedly siphon funds to support Pyongyang's military programs.

itens.t: South Korean defense chief meets counterparts to expand Southeast Asian ties
itens.r: South Korea's defense minister held strategic discussions with officials from Singapore and Vietnam aimed at broadening bilateral security cooperation.

itens.t: Samsung SDS aims to launch Asia's first Nvidia Vera Rubin cloud infrastructure
itens.r: Samsung SDS announced plans to deploy cutting-edge Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs by early 2027 to capture surging regional demand for artificial intelligence computing power.

itens.t: South Korean Army deploys AI tools to streamline administrative paperwork
itens.r: The South Korean military has successfully integrated specialized artificial intelligence software to automate routine paperwork and improve training efficiency.

itens.t: South Korean Navy training ship makes historic first port call in Florida
itens.r: A naval vessel carrying South Korean officer cadets arrived at a US naval base in Florida for the first historic port visit of its kind.

itens.t: South Korean President and Saudi Crown Prince discuss Mideast security over phone
itens.r: President Lee Jae Myung spoke with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed to reinforce bilateral cooperation amid ongoing geopolitical instabilities in the Middle East.

itens.t: North Korea appears to test propaganda loudspeaker broadcasts near border
itens.r: Border residents reported hearing audio testing from North Korea, prompting South Korean authorities to investigate potential renewed psychological warfare tactics.

itens.t: Netanyahu intensifies attacks on Arab parties at risk of losing power
itens.r: Benjamin Netanyahu claimed without evidence that the record growth of Arab parties in the elections was driven by electoral fraud. Arab leaders strongly denied the accusations.

itens.t: No one approved Flávio's letter and Bolsonaro didn't know about escape, says Valdemar
itens.r: PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto stated that former president Jair Bolsonaro was unaware of Flávio Bolsonaro's alleged plan to leave Brazil for the United States.

itens.t: Coritiba fires goalkeeper coach for assaulting Imperial/Athletico player
itens.r: Coritiba has dismissed the goalkeeping coach of its women's team following an assault on an Imperial/Athletico player.

itens.t: Obama admin first launched the investigation into Ilhan Omar's alleged brother marriage
itens.r: The investigation into whether Representative Ilhan Omar married her brother in a 2009 immigration fraud scheme began under former President Barack Obama in 2016.

itens.t: FOX One launches interactive election hub with real-time polling and race analysis
itens.r: FOX One unveiled a new interactive election experience giving users unprecedented access to results, real-time polling, and analysis for the midterms.

itens.t: Meta loses appeals against interim measures imposed by French regulators
itens.r: Tech giant Meta has lost its legal appeals against interim regulatory measures imposed by French authorities.

itens.t: Iran’s hidden web of military agencies is slipping hardware past the US blockade
itens.r: Reports reveal that a secretive network of Iranian military agencies continues to bypass the United States blockade to acquire restricted hardware.

itens.t: As US midterms approach, farmers decide what to plant and how to vote
itens.r: In Arkansas, rising operational costs inspired Hallie Shoffner's long-shot Senate campaign, raising questions about how local farmers will cast their votes.

itens.t: The universe in the eye of a telescope | Space photo of the day
itens.r: The Swedish-ESO Submillimetre Telescope captures the starry night sky at the La Silla Observatory in Chile in this striking astronomical photograph.

itens.t: Send Your Name to Titan Aboard NASA’s Dragonfly Mission
itens.r: NASA's 'Journey to Titan' campaign invites the public to submit their names to be carried on a microchip aboard the upcoming Dragonfly rotorcraft mission.

itens.t: NASA’s ISAM State of Play: The Industry Standard for Space Servicing
itens.r: NASA highlights industry advancements in In-Space Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacturing while preparing for upcoming underwater moonwalk simulations.

itens.t: North Korea Continues Installing New Fencing
itens.r: Recent satellite imagery indicates that North Korea is continuing the installation of new border fencing along sensitive strategic areas.

itens.t: How War Memorialization Legitimizes the Russia-DPRK Alliance
itens.r: An analysis explores how historical war memorialization is being utilized to legitimize the strengthening military alliance between Russia and North Korea.

itens.t: Chinese agency claims it’s organizing youth tours to North Korea’s Wonsan resort
itens.r: A Chinese travel agency claims it has been invited to organize youth tours to the Wonsan Kalma beach resort, though industry insiders express doubt.

itens.t: Border city casts doubt on reports North Korea testing loudspeakers
itens.r: A South Korean border municipality has raised doubts regarding local media reports that Pyongyang tested propaganda loudspeakers aimed across the border.

itens.t: Spy chief upholds Seoul's controversial repatriation of North Korean fishermen
itens.r: National Intelligence Service Director Lee Jong-seok defended the repatriation of two North Korean fishermen accused of killing 16 crew members.

itens.t: Lions manager gives kudos to bullpen after narrow KBO postseason win
itens.r: The Samsung Lions manager praised the performance of his relief pitchers following a hard-fought postseason victory in the Korea Baseball Organization.

itens.t: Dream postseason continues for Lions outfielder with clutch hit
itens.r: A Lions outfielder delivered a crucial clutch hit to continue his remarkable postseason run in the KBO playoffs.

itens.t: SpaceX Wants to Catch Both Halves of Starship. The Ship Must Fly Home Over Land
itens.r: SpaceX aims to catch both halves of the Starship rocket during Flight 15, requiring the spacecraft to fly back over land to reach the launch tower.
